learning_objective: ⚽ Learn to kick the ball with power and accuracy, stop a moving ball safely, and play amazing team football games!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Use the inside of your foot for the best control! Look at the ball, swing your leg back, and strike it firmly to send it zooming across the field.
When the ball is rolling fast toward you, stay calm. Use the bottom sole of your shoe to gently trap the ball so it stops right under your foot.
Football is all about teamwork! Look up to find your teammate, smile, and kick the ball exactly to their feet so they can keep the game going.

fun_activity.title: ⚽ The Wall Pass Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Find a safe outside wall. Kick a soft ball against the wall, and when it bounces back, trap it smoothly with your foot. Try to do it 10 times without letting it get away!

quick_recap: ⭐ Always use the inside of your foot for a careful and straight kick.
⭐ Trap a moving ball gently with the bottom of your shoe to stop it completely.
⭐ Look at your friends before kicking so the ball goes exactly where you want.
